title: [GAP-15] No operational security requirements for CO services
description: Review finding GAP-15: No operational security requirements for CO services (lens GAP). Location: spec/03-spaces.md:154, 184; spec/05-messaging.md:65, 204; spec/04-access-control.md:147; spec/12-security.md:101. Fix: Confirmed. §12.6 gives key-custody guidance for relays (12:101) and nothing for CO services. The most concrete gap is that member DID authentication is named twice and defined nowhere: "by DID authentication to the CO" (03:184), and "a DID it authenticates as a current member" for the registration service (05:204). Clients and CO services come from different implementers, so this is an interoperability gap, not just ops guidance. Define one challenge-response exchange, as proposed. Billing-key custody and registration-service availability overlap with GAP-2, so handle them here and drop them from GAP-2's fix. The fix is otherwise as proposed. Full text: notes/review/GAP-verified.md and notes/review/GAP.md.
close_reason: FIXED per notes/review/reconciliation.md: spec/12-security.md §12.8 Operational Security of CO Services (member auth, key custody incl. billing key, rate limits, audit logging, availability); spec/03-spaces.md §3.5 Member Authentication defines the single challenge-response exchange
